Meta.title: Callboard
Meta.description: Plan shoot days, assign crew and gear, and keep every call time current, even when the signal on location is weak.

Landing.title: The whole shoot, on one timeline.
Landing.lede: Callboard helps small crews plan shoot days, assign people and gear, and keep call times current, even when the signal on location is weak.

sample.label: A one-day schedule with three crew lanes, a marker for the current time and one double-booked person.

Design.title: Design system
Design.intro: Every colour, size and duration in Callboard comes from a named token. This page shows them in the active theme, so changing a preference below updates everything at once.
Design.typographySample: Review tomorrow's schedule and confirm your call time.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.signup: We sent a confirmation link to your inbox. Open it to finish creating your account.
checkEmail.recovery: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. It can take a minute to arrive.

errors.confirmationFailed: That confirmation link isn't valid any more. Request a new one.
errors.demoUnavailable: Demo sign-in isn't available right now.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

RoleSummary.owner: Runs the organization: members, settings and everything else.
RoleSummary.producer: Plans productions, schedules, crew and equipment.
RoleSummary.department_lead: Edits blocks and equipment for their own department.
RoleSummary.crew: Sees assigned productions, acknowledges call times, comments and adds photos.
